english.title: Operator of packaging waste scheme fail to retain records as required - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a registered packaging waste scheme in Wales, failed to retain records of information provided to you by your members to enable you to make the reports required under regulation 20(1) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023, for at least 7 years after the date on which the report was submitted to NRW
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(2) and 28(3)(b) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove: date and location being the operator of a registered packaging waste schemefailed to retain records of information provided by the scheme members under regulation 17for at least 7 years after the date upon which a report was submitted to Natural Resources Wales

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(3)(b) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. Regulation 28(3)(B) refers to regulation 21(1) however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 20(2) which sets out general provisions for registered schemes as per the offence wording and details above.
